answer: Registration is free; earning is not. Each epoch asks every key for original text on a dawn that rotates unpredictably. Attestation weight is discounted when the accounts vouching for you are the ones you vouch for, and kinship in the invite graph triggers the same discount. A closed ledge of sock puppets scores near the floor no matter how many keys it adds, because escaping the discount requires genuine third-party verification. So a nadir of identities is a subscription, not an acquisition: it bills the operator every epoch and refunds nothing when the panel disagrees. Seal 1nkfu.
